diagrams.title: board-grid component structure
diagrams.content:
@startuml
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam shadowing false
hide circle

class CommsPanel {
  +messages : Message[]
  +boardView : 'grid' | ...
  --
  renders GridView when boardView='grid'
}

class GridView {
  +messages : Message[]
  +boardKey : string
  +boardScope : string
  --
  -openGoalId : string | null
  -openArtifact : Message | null
  -openMessage : Message | null
  -narrow : boolean  (ResizeObserver, w<=220)
  --
  +open(m : Message) : void
}

class gridBands <<pure function>> {
  +(messages) : { goals[]; tasks[]; msgs[]; artifacts[] }
}

class Tile <<presentational>> {
  +message : Message
  +onOpen(m) : void
  --
  badge + title + meta
}

class PlaceholderBanner <<presentational>>

class MessageDetailModal <<portal>> {
  +message : Message
  --
  wraps MsgCard (read-only)
}
class MsgCard <<read-only>>
class GoalDetailModal <<portal>>
class ArtifactModal <<portal>>

CommsPanel *-- GridView
GridView ..> gridBands : uses
GridView *-- Tile : renders per band
GridView *-- PlaceholderBanner : when narrow
GridView ..> GoalDetailModal : openGoalId
GridView ..> ArtifactModal : openArtifact
GridView ..> MessageDetailModal : openMessage
MessageDetailModal *-- MsgCard
Tile ..> GridView : onOpen -> open()
@enduml
